STS2_CHARLOTTE_KEYWORD_SNAPSHOT.title: Snapshot
STS2_CHARLOTTE_KEYWORD_SNAPSHOT.descript: Choose a card in your hand and Exhaust it, adding a colorless card named "Snapshot Souvenir" to your draw pile: identical effect, type, cost and art to the original, with Exhaust. Statuses and Curses are not copied — draw 1 card instead.
STS2_CHARLOTTE_KEYWORD_FOCUS.title: Focus
STS2_CHARLOTTE_KEYWORD_FOCUS.description: A debuff. Whenever you Snapshot or play a News card, every unit holding Focus loses HP equal to its Focus stacks. At the end of the turn, Focus loses 1 stack.
STS2_CHARLOTTE_KEYWORD_NEWS.title: News
STS2_CHARLOTTE_KEYWORD_NEWS.description: A family of Ephemeral colorless cards generated by Charlotte's cards. Playing a News card triggers Focus.
